# GitHub Community Support

## Getting help

1. Read [docs/FAQ.md](../docs/FAQ.md)
2. Search [existing issues](https://github.com/Anandb71/LoRA-jit/issues)
3. Ask in [Discussions](https://github.com/Anandb71/LoRA-jit/discussions)

## Bug reports

Use the [bug report template](https://github.com/Anandb71/LoRA-jit/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml).

Include daemon logs, OS, Python version, and `.env` settings (redact API keys).

## Feature requests

Use the [feature request template](https://github.com/Anandb71/LoRA-jit/issues/new?template=feature_request.yml).

## Security

Do **not** open public issues for vulnerabilities. See [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md).
